method: Every PDF page opened at 1.5x via view_image; all 30 desktop/mobile first-viewport captures inspected; complete PDF reading supplies body-content/layout review. Independent validator checks all source blocks and full document bounds.
corrections: Preserved source metadata soft line breaks.
Removed non-source provenance-only PDF tail pages; provenance remains in HTML and manifests.
Kept clauses together to remove orphan words; widened table cells and used ordinary word wrapping.
Mobile tables retain readable columns with internal horizontal scrolling.
